# Support

Use the repository Issue Forms for reproducible bugs, feature proposals, and
hardware compatibility reports. Search existing issues first. Security matters
must follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), not a public issue.

This source-only experimental preview is maintained by the repository owner on
a best-effort basis. There is no guaranteed response time, maintenance window,
hardware compatibility, or continued binary distribution.

Before attaching diagnostics, remove usernames, device names, file paths,
network identifiers, notifications, process names, and any unrelated data.
Include the app version, Windows build, architecture, display/DPI layout, and
whether the value is incorrect or correctly unavailable as `N/A`.
